definitions.explanation: The first month of the year. In Japan, January is significant for New Year celebrations (お正月, oshōgatsu).

examples.japanese: {一月|いちがつ}に{日本|にほん}へ{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I'm going to Japan in January.

examples.japanese: {一月|いちがつ}は{寒|さむ}いです。
{一月|いちがつ}{一日|ついたち}は{元日|がんじつ}です。
{一月|いちがつ}の{初|はじ}めはお{正月|しょうがつ}で、みんな{休|やす}みます。
examples.english: The beginning of January is the New Year holiday, and everyone takes time off.

examples.japanese: {一月|いちがつ}は{一年|いちねん}で{一番|いちばん}{寒|さむ}い{月|つき}だと{言|い}われています。
examples.english: January is said to be the coldest month of the year.

notes:
{一月|いちがつ} is January - literally "month one."

MONTH PATTERN:
Number + {月|がつ} = month name. All 12 months follow this pattern.

PRONUNCIATION NOTE:
- {一月|いちがつ}: January (the month)
- {一月|ひとつき}: one month (duration) - different reading

CULTURAL SIGNIFICANCE:
- お{正月|しょうがつ}: New Year holiday (first days of January)
- {元日|がんじつ}/{元旦|がんたん}: New Year's Day (January 1st)
- {初詣|はつもうで}: first shrine visit of the year
- {成人|せいじん}の{日|ひ}: Coming of Age Day (second Monday)

NEW YEAR GREETINGS:
- {明|あ}けましておめでとうございます: Happy New Year
